| description = Flanked by four static [[Scorpikis Guardian]]s and one roaming up and down the length of the ramp.

For a solo method on obtaining the {{:Enchanted Emerald}}, use collaboration or similar faction spell on any scorpikis in the area. If you haven't ruined faction with [[Venril Sathir (Faction)|Venril Sathir]], you should start pretty close to non-KOS (went from apprehensive to aimiable with collaboration). This will allow you to walk down with no worries, right up to Impaler Tzilug. Once here, make sure you have [[Gate]] and [[Allure]] memmed and make sure you have SoW or Jboots active. Might also be a good time to get Rune/Berserker Strength up (all I had up was Berserker Strength since I was out of regeants). Get a "trade" (or hand-in) window up for Impaler with the dull emerald in it (can't hand items to pets that are fighting) but DO NOT press "give." Doing so will cause you to lose the gem. Cast charm on him and once he is your pet, quickly finish the "give" and he will hand you the enchanted gem. Run out of the tunnels leaving him behind to fight and gate at your earliest convenience.  If you're Amiable after faction spell, you can just turn it in without charming
